column2:
cabin(n.)小木屋、船艙、機艙
(無詞性變化)
log cabin 小木屋
cabin crew 空服人員
We stayed in a small cabin in the mountains.
(我們住在山上的一間小木屋。)
The cabin crew served drinks during the flight.
(空服人員在飛行途中提供飲料。)

cable(n./v.)纜線、電纜、有線電視、發電報
(無詞性變化)
cable TV 有線電視
cable car 纜車
We took a cable car up to Maokong.
(我們搭纜車上貓空。)
This cable connects the printer to the computer.
(這條線把印表機連接到電腦。)

cafeteria(n.)自助餐廳、學生餐廳
(無詞性變化)
school cafeteria 學校餐廳
cafeteria food 餐廳伙食
We usually eat lunch in the school cafeteria.
(我們通常在學校餐廳吃午餐。)
The cafeteria is crowded at noon.
(中午時自助餐廳很擁擠。)

campus(n.)校園
(無詞性變化)
on campus 在校園內
campus life 校園生活
Students are not allowed to smoke on campus.
(學生不得在校園內吸菸。)
She enjoys her campus life very much.
(她非常享受她的校園生活。)

canyon(n.)峽谷
(無詞性變化)
Grand Canyon 大峽谷
deep canyon 深谷
The river flows through a deep canyon.
(這條河流經一座深谷。)
Taroko is famous for its marble canyon.
(太魯閣以大理石峽谷聞名。)

capable(adj.)有能力的、能幹的
capability(n.)能力
incapable(adj.)無能力的
be capable of 有能力做……
highly capable 非常能幹
She is capable of solving difficult problems.
(她有能力解決困難的問題。)
We need a capable leader for this project.
(這個計畫需要一位能幹的領導者。)

captain(n.)船長、機長、隊長
(無詞性變化)
team captain 隊長
ship captain 船長
He was chosen as the captain of the basketball team.
(他被選為籃球隊隊長。)
The captain told the passengers to stay calm.
(機長要求乘客保持冷靜。)

capture(v./n.)捕捉、俘虜、吸引(注意)
captive(n.)俘虜
capture attention 吸引注意
capture the moment 捕捉那一刻
The photographer captured the beautiful sunset.
(攝影師捕捉到美麗的夕陽。)
The story captured the hearts of many readers.
(這個故事擄獲了許多讀者的心。)

career(n.)職業、生涯
(無詞性變化)
career goal 職涯目標
career choice 職業選擇
She wants to have a career in medicine.
(她想從事醫療方面的職業。)
He spent his whole career as a teacher.
(他整個職業生涯都在當老師。)

carpenter(n.)木匠
carpentry(n.)木工
skilled carpenter 熟練的木匠
hire a carpenter 請木匠
The carpenter made a new table for us.
(木匠為我們做了一張新桌子。)
My grandfather was a skilled carpenter.
(我祖父是一位手藝精湛的木匠。)

carpet(n./v.)地毯、鋪地毯
(無詞性變化)
red carpet 紅地毯
carpet floor 地毯地板
The stars walked down the red carpet.
(明星們走過紅地毯。)
The cat is sleeping on the carpet.
(貓正睡在地毯上。)

carriage(n.)馬車、車廂
carry(v.)攜帶、運送
horse-drawn carriage 馬車
baby carriage 嬰兒車
The princess rode in a golden carriage.
(公主坐在一輛金色馬車裡。)
The train has eight carriages.
(這列火車有八節車廂。)

cart(n./v.)手推車、運貨馬車、用車運送
(無詞性變化)
shopping cart 購物車
push a cart 推車
He put the groceries in the shopping cart.
(他把雜貨放進購物車。)
The workers carted the bricks away.
(工人們用推車把磚塊運走。)

cast(v./n.)投擲、投射、演員陣容、石膏
(無詞性變化)
cast a shadow 投下陰影
cast a vote 投票
The tall tree cast a long shadow.
(那棵高大的樹投下長長的影子。)
The movie has an amazing cast.
(這部電影的演員陣容很強。)

casual(adj.)隨意的、非正式的、偶然的
casually(adv.)隨意地
casual clothes 便服
casual conversation 閒聊
You can wear casual clothes on Friday.
(星期五你可以穿便服。)
We had a casual chat over coffee.
(我們邊喝咖啡邊隨意聊天。)

cattle(n.)牛(集合名詞)
(無詞性變化)
raise cattle 養牛
herd of cattle 一群牛
The farmer raises cattle and sheep.
(這位農夫養牛和羊。)
A herd of cattle was eating grass in the field.
(一群牛在田野上吃草。)

cave(n./v.)洞穴、塌陷
caveman(n.)穴居人
cave in 塌陷
explore a cave 探索洞穴
The bats live in a dark cave.
(蝙蝠住在一個黑暗的洞穴裡。)
The roof of the old house caved in.
(那棟老房子的屋頂塌了。)

champion(n.)冠軍、擁護者
championship(n.)冠軍賽、冠軍頭銜
world champion 世界冠軍
defending champion 衛冕冠軍
She became the national tennis champion.
(她成為全國網球冠軍。)
Our team is the defending champion.
(我們隊是衛冕冠軍。)

charm(n./v.)魅力、吸引、護身符
charming(adj.)迷人的
lucky charm 幸運物
charm sb. 迷住某人
The old town has a special charm.
(這座古鎮有種特別的魅力。)
She charmed everyone with her smile.
(她的笑容迷倒了每個人。)

chat(n./v.)聊天、閒談
chatty(adj.)愛聊天的
have a chat 聊一聊
chat online 線上聊天
We had a nice chat after class.
(下課後我們愉快地聊了一下。)
I often chat with my friends online.
(我常常和朋友在網路上聊天。)

cheek(n.)臉頰
cheeky(adj.)厚臉皮的
rosy cheeks 紅潤的臉頰
kiss on the cheek 親吻臉頰
Tears ran down her cheeks.
(淚水從她的臉頰流下。)
The baby has round, rosy cheeks.
(這個寶寶有圓圓紅潤的臉頰。)

cheerful(adj.)開朗的、愉快的
cheer(v.)歡呼、使高興
cheerfully(adv.)愉快地
cheerful smile 開朗的笑容
cheerful mood 愉快的心情
Our teacher is always cheerful and kind.
(我們的老師總是開朗又親切。)
The bright colors make the room look cheerful.
(明亮的色彩讓房間看起來很愉快。)

cherry(n./adj.)櫻桃、櫻花樹、櫻桃色的
(無詞性變化)
cherry blossom 櫻花
cherry tree 櫻花樹
We went to Alishan to see the cherry blossoms.
(我們去阿里山看櫻花。)
There is a cherry on top of the cake.
(蛋糕上面有一顆櫻桃。)

chest(n.)胸部、箱子
(無詞性變化)
chest pain 胸痛
treasure chest 寶箱
He felt a sharp pain in his chest.
(他感到胸口一陣劇痛。)
The pirates hid a treasure chest on the island.
(海盜們把寶箱藏在島上。)

chill(n./v./adj.)寒意、使變冷、冷的
chilly(adj.)寒冷的
chill out 放輕鬆
catch a chill 著涼
There is a chill in the air this morning.
(今天早上空氣中有股寒意。)
Chill the juice in the fridge before serving.
(上桌前把果汁放冰箱冰一下。)

chilly(adj.)寒冷的、冷淡的
chill(n.)寒意
chilly morning 寒冷的早晨
chilly wind 冷風
It's chilly outside, so take a jacket.
(外面很冷，帶件外套吧。)
He received a chilly welcome from his neighbors.
(他受到鄰居們冷淡的接待。)

chimney(n.)煙囪
(無詞性變化)
factory chimney 工廠煙囪
come down the chimney 從煙囪下來
Smoke was rising from the chimney.
(煙從煙囪裡冒出來。)
Santa Claus comes down the chimney on Christmas Eve.
(聖誕老人在平安夜從煙囪下來。)

chin(n.)下巴
(無詞性變化)
chin up 振作起來
double chin 雙下巴
He rested his chin on his hand.
(他用手托著下巴。)
Keep your chin up and try again.
(振作起來再試一次。)

chip(n./v.)碎片、晶片、洋芋片、削下
(無詞性變化)
potato chips 洋芋片
computer chip 電腦晶片
We ate potato chips while watching the movie.
(我們一邊看電影一邊吃洋芋片。)
Taiwan is famous for making computer chips.
(台灣以製造電腦晶片聞名。)

chop(n./v.)砍、剁、切碎、排骨
chopper(n.)切肉刀、直升機(口語)
chop up 切碎
pork chop 豬排
Chop the onions into small pieces.
(把洋蔥切成小塊。)
I had a pork chop with rice for lunch.
(我午餐吃排骨飯。)

cigarette(n.)香菸
(無詞性變化)
smoke a cigarette 抽菸
cigarette butt 菸蒂
Smoking cigarettes is bad for your health.
(抽菸對健康有害。)
Don't throw cigarette butts on the street.
(不要把菸蒂丟在街上。)

cinema(n.)電影院、電影
cinematic(adj.)電影的
go to the cinema 去看電影
cinema ticket 電影票
Let's go to the cinema this weekend.
(這個週末我們去看電影吧。)
The new cinema has very comfortable seats.
(新電影院的座位非常舒適。)

circus(n.)馬戲團
(無詞性變化)
circus clown 馬戲團小丑
circus performer 馬戲團表演者
The children laughed at the circus clown.
(孩子們被馬戲團小丑逗得哈哈大笑。)
The circus comes to town every summer.
(馬戲團每年夏天都會來鎮上。)

citizen(n.)公民、市民
citizenship(n.)公民身分
senior citizen 年長者
good citizen 好公民
Every citizen has the right to vote.
(每位公民都有投票權。)
Senior citizens can take the bus for free.
(年長者可以免費搭公車。)

civil(adj.)公民的、民用的、有禮貌的
civilian(n.)平民
civil war 內戰
civil rights 公民權
The country suffered from a long civil war.
(這個國家飽受長期內戰之苦。)
Martin Luther King fought for civil rights.
(馬丁‧路德‧金恩為公民權利奮鬥。)

clay(n.)黏土、陶土
(無詞性變化)
clay pot 陶罐
modeling clay 黏土
The children made animals out of clay.
(孩子們用黏土做動物。)
This clay pot was made by hand.
(這個陶罐是手工做的。)

cleaner(n.)清潔工、清潔劑、吸塵器
clean(v./adj.)清潔、乾淨的
vacuum cleaner 吸塵器
glass cleaner 玻璃清潔劑
The cleaner comes to clean our office every night.
(清潔工每晚都會來打掃我們的辦公室。)
Use a vacuum cleaner to clean the carpet.
(用吸塵器清理地毯。)

client(n.)客戶、委託人
clientele(n.)客戶群
meet a client 會見客戶
regular client 常客
The lawyer is meeting with a client now.
(律師現在正在會見一位委託人。)
We must keep our clients happy.
(我們必須讓客戶滿意。)

clinic(n.)診所
clinical(adj.)臨床的
dental clinic 牙醫診所
go to the clinic 去診所
I went to the clinic because I had a fever.
(我因為發燒去了診所。)
The dental clinic opens at nine.
(那間牙醫診所九點開門。)

clip(n./v.)夾子、片段、修剪、夾住
clipper(n.)指甲剪、剪刀
paper clip 迴紋針
video clip 影片片段
Use a paper clip to hold these pages together.
(用迴紋針把這幾頁夾在一起。)
He watched a funny video clip online.
(他在網路上看了一段搞笑影片。)

closet(n.)衣櫥、壁櫥
(無詞性變化)
walk-in closet 更衣間
clothes closet 衣櫃
Hang your coat in the closet.
(把你的外套掛進衣櫥。)
Her closet is full of dresses.
(她的衣櫥裡滿是洋裝。)

clothe(v.)給……穿衣、提供衣服
clothes(n.)衣服
clothing(n.)衣物(總稱)
feed and clothe 供吃供穿
be clothed in 穿著……
Parents work hard to feed and clothe their children.
(父母努力工作供孩子吃穿。)
The bride was clothed in white.
(新娘身穿白衣。)

clown(n./v.)小丑、搞笑的人、扮小丑
(無詞性變化)
class clown 班上的開心果
clown around 胡鬧
He is the class clown and always makes us laugh.
(他是班上的開心果，總是逗我們笑。)
Stop clowning around and do your homework.
(別再胡鬧了，去寫功課。)

clue(n.)線索、提示
clueless(adj.)毫無頭緒的
find a clue 找到線索
have no clue 毫無頭緒
The police found an important clue.
(警方找到一個重要線索。)
I have no clue what he is talking about.
(我完全不知道他在說什麼。)

coach(n./v.)教練、長途巴士、指導
(無詞性變化)
head coach 總教練
coach a team 指導球隊
Our coach makes us run every morning.
(我們教練每天早上要我們跑步。)
She coaches the school volleyball team.
(她指導學校的排球隊。)

cock(n.)公雞
(無詞性變化)
cock crow 雞鳴
fighting cock 鬥雞
The cock crowed at dawn.
(公雞在黎明時啼叫。)
A cock was walking around the farmyard.
(一隻公雞在農家院子裡走來走去。)

cocktail(n.)雞尾酒
(無詞性變化)
cocktail party 雞尾酒會
fruit cocktail 什錦水果
They served fruit cocktail as dessert.
(他們端上什錦水果當甜點。)
My parents went to a cocktail party last night.
(我爸媽昨晚去參加了雞尾酒會。)

coconut(n.)椰子
(無詞性變化)
coconut milk 椰奶
coconut tree 椰子樹
We drank fresh coconut water on the beach.
(我們在海灘上喝新鮮的椰子水。)
Coconut trees line the road in Kenting.
(墾丁的道路兩旁種滿椰子樹。)

collar(n.)衣領、項圈
(無詞性變化)
shirt collar 襯衫領子
dog collar 狗項圈
There is a stain on your shirt collar.
(你的襯衫領子上有汙漬。)
The dog wears a red collar.
(那隻狗戴著紅色項圈。)

collection(n.)收集、收藏品、募捐
collect(v.)收集
collector(n.)收藏家
stamp collection 集郵
garbage collection 垃圾收集
He has a large collection of stamps.
(他收藏了大量郵票。)
The museum has a famous collection of Chinese art.
(這間博物館有著名的中國藝術收藏。)

colony(n.)殖民地、群體
colonial(adj.)殖民的
colonize(v.)殖民
former colony 前殖民地
ant colony 蟻群
Hong Kong was once a British colony.
(香港曾經是英國的殖民地。)
An ant colony can have thousands of ants.
(一個蟻群可以有數千隻螞蟻。)

colorful(adj.)色彩繽紛的、多采多姿的
color(n.)顏色
colorful flowers 色彩繽紛的花
colorful life 多采多姿的生活
The garden is full of colorful flowers.
(花園裡開滿了色彩繽紛的花。)
My grandfather has had a colorful life.
(我祖父有著多采多姿的人生。)

column(n.)圓柱、專欄、(表格)直行
columnist(n.)專欄作家
stone column 石柱
newspaper column 報紙專欄
The temple is supported by huge stone columns.
(這座廟由巨大的石柱支撐。)
She writes a weekly column for a newspaper.
(她每週為一家報紙寫專欄。)

comfort(n./v.)舒適、安慰
comfortable(adj.)舒適的
comfortably(adv.)舒適地
comfort zone 舒適圈
in comfort 舒適地
She tried to comfort her crying friend.
(她試著安慰哭泣的朋友。)
Try to step out of your comfort zone.
(試著走出你的舒適圈。)

comma(n.)逗號
(無詞性變化)
put a comma 加逗號
comma splice 逗號誤接
Put a comma after the word 'however'.
(在 however 這個字後面加逗號。)
You forgot a comma in this sentence.
(你在這個句子裡漏了一個逗號。)

committee(n.)委員會
(無詞性變化)
student committee 學生委員會
committee meeting 委員會會議
The committee will make a decision next week.
(委員會將在下週做出決定。)
She is a member of the school committee.
(她是學校委員會的成員。)

communicate(v.)溝通、傳達
communication(n.)溝通
communicative(adj.)健談的、溝通的
communicate with 與……溝通
communicate ideas 傳達想法
It is important to communicate with your parents.
(和父母溝通很重要。)
We communicate by email most of the time.
(我們大多透過電子郵件聯絡。)

comparison(n.)比較、比喻
compare(v.)比較
comparative(adj.)比較的
in comparison with 與……相比
make a comparison 做比較
In comparison with last year, sales have increased.
(和去年相比，銷售量增加了。)
There is no comparison between the two phones.
(這兩支手機根本無法相比。)

compete(v.)競爭、參賽
competition(n.)競爭、比賽
competitive(adj.)競爭的
compete with 與……競爭
compete for 爭奪
Ten teams will compete for the prize.
(十支隊伍將爭奪這個獎項。)
Small shops find it hard to compete with big stores.
(小商店很難與大賣場競爭。)

complain(v.)抱怨、投訴
complaint(n.)抱怨、投訴
complain about 抱怨……
complain to 向……投訴
He always complains about the weather.
(他總是抱怨天氣。)
We complained to the manager about the noise.
(我們向經理投訴噪音問題。)

complaint(n.)抱怨、投訴
complain(v.)抱怨
make a complaint 投訴
customer complaint 客訴
The hotel received many complaints about the noise.
(飯店收到許多關於噪音的投訴。)
If you are not happy, you can make a complaint.
(如果你不滿意，可以提出投訴。)

concert(n.)音樂會、演唱會
(無詞性變化)
go to a concert 去聽演唱會
concert hall 音樂廳
We went to Mayday's concert last night.
(我們昨晚去看了五月天的演唱會。)
The orchestra will perform at the concert hall.
(管弦樂團將在音樂廳演出。)

conclusion(n.)結論、結尾
conclude(v.)下結論、結束
conclusive(adj.)決定性的
in conclusion 總而言之
come to a conclusion 得出結論
In conclusion, exercise is good for everyone.
(總而言之，運動對每個人都有益。)
Don't jump to conclusions too quickly.
(不要太快下結論。)

cone(n.)圓錐體、甜筒、毬果
(無詞性變化)
ice cream cone 冰淇淋甜筒
traffic cone 交通錐
She bought a chocolate ice cream cone.
(她買了一支巧克力冰淇淋甜筒。)
Traffic cones were placed around the hole.
(洞的周圍擺放了交通錐。)

confirm(v.)確認、證實
confirmation(n.)確認
confirm a booking 確認預訂
confirm the news 證實消息
Please call to confirm your reservation.
(請打電話確認您的訂位。)
The doctor confirmed that the bone was broken.
(醫生證實骨頭斷了。)

confuse(v.)使困惑、混淆
confusion(n.)困惑、混亂
confused(adj.)困惑的
confusing(adj.)令人困惑的
confuse A with B 把 A 和 B 搞混
confusing instructions 令人困惑的說明
I always confuse him with his twin brother.
(我總是把他和他的雙胞胎弟弟搞混。)
The teacher's explanation confused the students.
(老師的解釋讓學生們很困惑。)

connect(v.)連接、聯繫
